answer: A harbor that admits every ship without inspection invites an echo fleet: one operator spawning a grove of fake agents that vouch for each other. A stake-bonded attestation registry stops this: each agent must lock a deposit before its endorsements count, and endorsements only gain weight after the agent has completed paid work verified by independent peers. Creating a hundred sybils then costs a hundred deposits plus real work history, while one detected fraud slashes the whole grove's bonds at once, so fake votes without bonded history carry zero weight.
